name: Waymarked Trails (Hiking)
coverage: Worldwide map layer of OSM hiking route relations
source: OpenStreetMap route relations tagged iwn/nwn/rwn/lwn
quality_mark: No quality mark; shows the OSM network level (international/national/regional/local)
curated: No; shows whatever OSM mappers tagged as routes
open_data: Yes, OSM (ODbL); site has no robots.txt (404)
gap: Signed routes only, not 'recommended loops'; levels are tagged inconsistently by country; no day-hike filter or tourism-office mark

name: Komoot
source: Users, Komoot editors, partner tourism boards and brands (Collections)
quality_mark: Highlights are community-rated; Collections come from editors, partners and friends; no official-route mark found
curated: Mixed: Collections partly curated, rest is a large user pile
open_data: No (not checked in detail); robots.txt exists
gap: No separation of official versus user routes; sponsored collections possible; closed data

name: Outdooractive / Alpenvereinaktiv
coverage: Europe-wide, densest in DACH; Alpenvereinaktiv is the Alpine clubs' portal run on the same platform
source: Destinations, tourism offices, guides, Alpine clubs, users; 'Alliance of the Officials' partner programme
quality_mark: Partner/publisher attribution and a Pro+ premium tier; exact 'official' badge not verified; homepage (direct) says routes are recommended by mountain guides, trail wardens and industry pros; alpenvereinaktiv.com menu (direct) has 'Recommended Tours' and Pro tier
curated: Mixed: official partner content plus user content
open_data: No; robots.txt disallows GPX download paths and sets ai-train=no
gap: Closest content match for DACH but closed, commercial, and official versus user routes not cleanly filterable (not verified); thin outside DACH

name: AllTrails
source: Users and curated trail pages; claims verified routes plus OSM segments
quality_mark: Curated Trails vs Community Content (third-party description)
gap: US-centred, not official-route based, closed data

name: Wikiloc
source: Users
gap: Unfiltered user tracks; site blocked my curl with a bot challenge (403), so not opened

name: Bergfex
source: not checked
gap: Site returned a bot challenge (403) and robots.txt disallows my agent; not fetched

name: Mapy.com (Mapy.cz)
coverage: World maps, strongest in Czechia and Central Europe
source: Map shows hiking trails (OSM-based marked trails; Czech KCT marked trails)
curated: Not checked; map layer rather than a route catalogue
gap: Map layer of marked trails, no loop catalogue or official mark checked

name: OsmAnd and Organic Maps route layers
coverage: Worldwide, wherever OSM has route relations
source: OSM route relations (lwn/rwn/nwn/iwn)
gap: Same as Waymarked Trails; display only, no loop browsing or filtering by quality

name: European Ramblers Association: Leading Quality Trails (LQT), Quality Day Walk
coverage: Certified trails in many European countries; Day Walk certificate for 4-25 km exists
source: ERA certification by audit; valid 3 years then re-tested
gap: Very few routes (mostly multi-day, min 50 km); Day Walk list size not checked; ERA site returned 503 to my curl, so facts are from search

name: SchweizMobil / Wanderland Schweiz
coverage: Switzerland and Liechtenstein; national, regional, local routes
source: Federal Roads Office (ASTRA) with cantonal bodies
open_data: Yes: opendata.swiss and geo.admin.ch, 'open use, cite source' (lead); robots.txt allows all (direct)
gap: One country only; routes are network stages, not 'loops' chosen for day hikes

name: UT.no
source: DNT and member associations, Statskog, Norwegian Environment Agency, Kartverket; volunteers write and verify; municipalities and companies add content
quality_mark: Marked routes and trip suggestions; no explicit badge seen
open_data: Not checked; robots.txt disallows GPX paths
gap: Norway only, Norwegian language only (lead)

name: Naturkartan
coverage: Sweden; municipalities, counties and trail organisations
source: Customer organisations (about 170 per a search snippet)
curated: Yes, by organisations that pay to join (lead)
gap: Sweden only; no cross-country view

name: udinaturen.dk
source: Not checked; links to Danmarks Naturstier and Danske Naturparker (Friluftsrådet quality mark)
quality_mark: Danske Naturparker is called Friluftsrådet's quality mark (direct page text)
gap: Denmark only

name: Luontoon.fi
coverage: Finland; national parks to municipal recreation areas
source: Metsahallitus (state forest and park agency)
gap: Finland only

name: Geoportail Luxembourg
source: State geoportal
gap: Page is a JavaScript app; I saw only the title. LQT trails such as Mullerthal Trail exist in Luxembourg (lead)

name: Sport Ireland: Find Your Trails (irishtrails.ie)
source: Sport Ireland national trails; National Waymarked Ways
gap: Ireland only

name: Wanderbares Deutschland (Deutscher Wanderverband)
coverage: Germany; menu: long and short Qualitaetswege, quality regions, long-distance trails, Leading Quality Trails
source: Certification by the Deutscher Wanderverband; operators apply
gap: Germany only; certified set is small compared with all local loops; no cross-country view

name: Deutsches Wanderinstitut (Premiumwege)
source: Independent hiking experts audit trails against 34 criteria (lead)
gap: Mostly Germany; closest to 'signed trailhead-board loops' but no pan-European list

name: FFRandonnee / MonGR
source: Federation labels GR, GR de Pays, PR routes
quality_mark: Yes, federation labels (known; not verified on page)
gap: mongr.fr opened (direct): described as site of long-distance (itinerant) walking, GR routes, RandoPass; not day loops. France only

name: IGNrando / IGN route portal
source: IGN, partner route providers
gap: Closed: FFRandonnee reports ignrando.fr stopped on 20 Nov 2025 (lead, snippet); replacement named inconsistently (WeTrek or MaRando); IGN now pushes the 'Cartes IGN' app

name: Visorando
source: Users and tourism bodies (not verified)
open_data: Not checked; robots.txt allows crawling except admin paths
gap: Quality and official status not visible on the home page

name: Cirkwi
source: Tourism offices and professionals (they pay to publish; lead from Geotrek slides)
open_data: Not checked; robots.txt disallows GPX export paths
gap: Close to the wish in France as it holds tourism-office content; closed export

name: FEDME (Spain)
source: Federation says it regulates and manages senderismo; homologated trails (GR, PR, SL)
gap: Trail site not opened; only the federation home page

name: CAI (Italy): Sentiero Italia and regional portals
source: Club Alpino Italiano
gap: Only home page opened; no regional portals checked. DIGIWAY (Interreg Italy-Austria) publishes hiking network data on NOI Open Data Hub (lead)

name: maPZS (Slovenia)
source: Alpine Association of Slovenia and its clubs
gap: Mountain trails, not day loops; app not opened

name: Hrvatski planinarski savez (HPS) and Sigurne staze (Croatia)
source: HPS trail registry; HGSS Sigurne staze uses verified HPS data
gap: Safety map rather than loop browser; sigurnestaze.hr not opened

name: Walking Britain
source: Site author's own walks (not verified)
gap: Not official routes

name: OS Maps
source: Ordnance Survey plus user and partner routes
gap: GB only; closed

name: Wandelnet (Netherlands)
coverage: Netherlands; route menu (direct) lists LAW long-distance routes, Streekpaden, Rondwandelingen (circular walks), Stadswandelingen, plus a 'Routedatabank' for professionals
source: Wandelnet (national walking body)
gap: Has a circular-walk category, but NL only; whether Rondwandelingen are official or user-made not checked

name: Geotrek ecosystem, data.gouv.fr rando datasets, DATAtourisme (France)
coverage: France: parks and departments publish trails via Geotrek, synced with Apidae, Tourinsoft, Cirkwi, Outdooractive
source: Official bodies (parks, departments, tourism agencies)
open_data: Partly: national trail data schema on schema.data.gouv.fr; some parks publish GeoJSON (lead)
gap: France-only data plumbing, not a browsing site

name: EU tourism data space and Interreg DIGIWAY
coverage: EU policy; DIGIWAY covers hiking network data in Trentino/South Tyrol/Austria
source: Official bodies
open_data: DIGIWAY output on Open Data Hub (lead)
gap: No EU-wide trail database found

name: HiiKER
source: Not checked (own 'HiiKER Hikes' plus 'Community Hikes')
quality_mark: Separates HiiKER Hikes from Community Hikes (direct menu)
gap: Mostly long trails; closed; official status not checked

name: Open Data Hub (NOI Techpark, South Tyrol)
coverage: South Tyrol / Trentino region data platform
source: Official data providers
open_data: Yes, open data platform (direct homepage); hiking datasets not checked
gap: One region; not a browsing site
